tools.name: read_docx
tools.description: Read paragraphs and tables from a Word document

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

tools.name: write_docx
tools.description: Create, replace, or append to a Word document: title, body paragraphs, multi-level headings, tables, page size/margins (A4 default) and fonts (East Asian font set by default). Unknown fields are refused, never silently dropped.

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

title.description: Document title (Title style), written before the blocks

paragraphs.description: Document body in order. A bare string is a body paragraph; use heading blocks for section titles (e.g. 一、总体情况) instead of body text.

rows.description: Rectangular grid of cell strings; row 0 is the header when header=true

page.description: Page geometry. New documents default to A4 portrait with 25.4 mm margins; when appending, page is only changed if this field is given (then unspecified margins reset to 25.4 mm).

font.description: Document-default fonts. New documents always get an East Asian font (宋体 unless eastAsia is given); when appending, fonts only change if this field is given.

eastAsia.description: CJK font family, e.g. 宋体 / 黑体 / 微软雅黑

latin.description: Latin font family, e.g. Times New Roman

tools.name: read_xlsx
tools.description: Read cell values from every worksheet in an Excel workbook

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

tools.name: write_xlsx
tools.description: Create a workbook or update addressed cells in an existing workbook

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

tools.name: read_pptx
tools.description: Read text from every slide in a PowerPoint deck

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

tools.name: write_pptx
tools.description: Create, replace, or append text slides in a PowerPoint deck

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

tools.name: read_pdf
tools.description: Extract the text layer from every PDF page

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

tools.name: write_pdf
tools.description: Generate a text PDF, replace its text document, or append text pages

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

tools.name: info
tools.description: Probe a local video or audio file; paths are resolved in the current Location.

tools.name: transcript
tools.description: Read the complete local transcript with source timestamps and speakers. A range filters the result, never audio coverage.

tools.name: frames
tools.description: Extract exact, interval or scene frames with source timestamps and local OCR.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find text or a time range in a locally cached transcript, with surrounding sentences.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export subtitles, a transcript or frames into the current project.

tools.name: clip
tools.description: Precisely export a source time range as MP4/H.264/AAC or M4A/AAC.

tools.name: gif
tools.description: Export a video source time range as a playable palette-encoded GIF.

tools.name: download
tools.description: Download a public video page through the existing network policy; no login or browser cookies.
